ambiguities.text: The phrase 'last slot of epoch N+1' requires precise definition of slot boundaries relative to epoch transitions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'last slot of epoch N+1' means slot (N+2)*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH - 1, which is the final slot before epoch N+2 begins.

ambiguities.text: The specification mentions 'fast confirmation rule' enables 3-4 slot confirmations but doesn't define the exact mechanism.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this refers to separate confirmation rule specifications and this EIP only provides the extended window prerequisite.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network latency and propagation delays are bounded such that attestations can reach proposers within the extended window.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attestations from validators with high latency may still miss inclusion despite the extended window.

implicit_assumptions.description: Block proposers have sufficient bandwidth and processing capacity to handle the increased number of valid attestations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Proposers may be overwhelmed and unable to include all valid attestations, reducing network security.

implicit_assumptions.description: The extended window improves LMD-GHOST security as claimed without introducing new attack vectors.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could potentially exploit the longer inclusion window for reorganization attacks or other manipulation.
